plugins.name: next-steps-desktop
plugins.description: next-steps with a Claude Code Desktop renderer: suggests up to three next prompts, above the input in the terminal and behind a 💡 footer chip and Next steps pane on Desktop; a press puts one in the composer as a draft

plugins.name: plan-progress
plugins.description: plan-progress (zycck/claude-mods) with its rules sent through prompt.submit, so they reach the model where prompt.compose is skipped for user plugins; on Desktop the bars live in a Progress pane with step times and history

plugins.name: cache-timer
plugins.description: A dim Cache mm:ss countdown in the Claude Code Desktop footer: how long the prompt cache stays warm since the last model response

plugins.name: session-hub
plugins.description: One Mod status pane for Claude Code Desktop with an icon rail: Progress bars, Next steps suggestions and the prompt-cache countdown, opened from one footer entry
